asset.name: PDFViewer
asset.description: The lazily loaded document viewer with page windowing, search, zoom, thumbnails, text selection, download, and an accessible text fallback for the rendered pages.

requires.reason: Page windowing and focus preservation are shared.
In-document search shares entry, debouncing, and cancellation.

rationale: The text fallback is the requirement: a PDF rendered only to canvas is completely opaque to assistive technology, which is the default outcome of every naive integration.
